SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales

SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT city, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY city

SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name

natural_language_question: Which inventory items are below reorder level?

SELECT i.product_id, p.name, i.warehouse, i.stock, i.reorder_level
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
